newsitem.title: NORWAY: NORDIC SKIING-PROFILE OF WOMEN'S 5-KM CROSS-COUNTRY WINNER.
newsitem.headline: NORDIC SKIING-PROFILE OF WOMEN'S 5-KM CROSS-COUNTRY WINNER.

text.p: Profile of the winner of Sunday's women's 5-km classical style cross-country race at the Nordic skiing world championships:
Previous world titles: three -- relay and 30-km freestyle in 1991 in Val di Fiemme, Italy; relay in 1993 in Falun, Sweden.

Other facts: She struggled to recapture her best form after winning three gold medals at the 1994 winter Olympics in Lillehammer. After the games, she retired to give birth to a son, Viktor, and then experienced health problems.
